profile.headline: Retired Solution Architect / Full Stack Developer
profile.summary: Versatile and accomplished technology professional with a strong track record of designing, developing and delivering successful software projects. Strategic thinker skilled at communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences to achieve business goals.

positions.title: Senior Technology Consultant
positions.description:
Developed enterprise application architect. Researched and applied new technologies to support core business initiatives. Managed outsourcing vendors. Coordinated content management and records management technologies.  

Key Achievements
Led enterprise wide SharePoint implementation.
Led enterprise-wide deployment of PDF Creator saving $750K in PDF management costs

positions.title: Solutions Architect/Technical Lead
positions.description:
Developed and implemented complex application integration. Led design of enterprise applications. Designed software frameworks. Developed and implemented enterprise web services.

Key Achievements
Key architect in enterprise Service Oriented Architecture.
Led design and development of global manager research system Integrating Sharepoint, Microsoft Office and Interaction CRM.

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
Acted as Lead Developer, Senior Systems Analyst and Architect in delivering numerous Client Server, Web Services and Process driven solutions in the Microsoft Application Space.

Key Achievements
Redesigned and implemented mission critical manager research system – remained in service 15 years.
Designed and developed enterprise data interchange service.
Designed and developed key pieces of the enterprise web service architecture.

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description:
Led analysis and design of LAN based database applications, choosing development tools and making technology recommendations. 

Key Achievement
Designed and developed the first client-server application in the company.

positions.title: Technical Analyst
positions.description:
Desktop and Mainframe application support. 
Technical support database design and support

positions.title: Director of Computer Writing Labs
positions.description:
Managed and administered computer labs serving the university campus.  Provided technical leadership and advice.  Defined and implemented infrastructure related to hardware, software and administration.  Designed computer writing labs. Supervised lab staff.

Key Achievements
Won two $50,000 grants for hardware and software. 
Integrated style analysis into curriculum resulting in national recognition of the program.
